name: pail-verify
description: Quint model of pail's publish protocol and the tools that check it

scripts.compile: npm run compile:publish && npm run compile:store
scripts.check: npm run compile:publish -- --check && npm run compile:store -- --check
scripts.test: quint test store_scenarios.qnt --main=storeScenarios --match='Run$' && quint test scenarios.qnt --main=scenarios --match='Run$'
